text:
sophia: heads up — onboarding guide has a broken external link, scan flagged it as 404. anyone owning the runtime-onboarding doc?
link-scan-bot: automated scan result: 1 dead external link found -> https://docs.gov-api.example/endpoint (404) in docs/runtime/onboarding.md at ~line 120
maria: i can take a quick look, which file path is it?
sophia: docs/runtime/onboarding.md — it's the auth callback curl example, users hit a 404 when following the sample
samir: can reproduce locally. the link points to an external gov hosted page that appears removed. i can open a tiny PR to rehost the snippet and swap to an archived link or our snapshot copy
maria: please add me as reviewer when you open the PR. also watch frontmatter/slug — if we touch the file might need a redirect
samir: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — replaced external link with archived copy, updated example curl to use archived endpoint and added a note that it's rehosted. tests passing :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: deploy preview available -> https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai/ (preview expires in 7 days)
jack: small nit — the curl example used `--insecure`. recommend switching to `--cacert /path/to/ca.pem` or `--tlsv1.2` so it's not encouraging insecure usage
samir: good catch, swapped `--insecure` to `--cacert` in the PR and noted the change in the PR description
maria: LGTM, left review and approved :eyes:
sophia: awesome, thanks y'all. two quick follow-ups: 1) can we add an `owners: ["maria"]` field to the top of the doc so future link scans ping the right person, and 2) please add a short changelog line so support can tell users it was rehosted
maria: yep i can add owners in a follow-up PR. if docs-custodians want to adopt the page permanently i'm happy to hand off
samir: merging once CI completes. will notify #support with the changelog blurb after deploy
sophia: perfect — thanks everyone :tada:
